info.name: DePix — core flow
info.description: Generated from the live DePix OpenAPI (3.1.0, info.version 0.18.0) by collections/gen-collections.mjs. Set {{apiKey}} to an sk_test_/sk_live_ key. Do not hand-edit — regenerate.

request.description: Creates a charge with a PIX QR and hosted payment page. Requires scope `merchant_write` on the API-key path; a merchant profile is required. sk_test_ creates a sandbox checkout (non-payable placeholder QR — complete it via simulate-payment). Track via GET /api/checkouts/{id} polling or checkout.* webhooks. Supports Idempotency-Key.
Paginated checkout list for the authenticated merchant, filtered to the key's mode (sk_test_ sees only sandbox checkouts). Requires scope `merchant_read` on the API-key path.

Full checkout detail (owner view). `pix_payload` is present only while pending. Poll until a terminal status (see the status enum) or subscribe to checkout.* webhooks. Requires scope `merchant_read` on the API-key path.
Completes a SANDBOX checkout as if it were paid (fires checkout.completed when a callback URL is set). Live checkouts are 403 sandbox_only. Requires scope `merchant_write` on the API-key path.

Probe endpoint: returns the merchant behind the credentials. 404 (not 403) when the account has no merchant profile — integrators use that to tell "valid key, no merchant yet" apart. Requires scope `merchant_read` on the API-key path.
This route requires per-request Ed25519 signing (X-Agent-* headers), not a static Bearer token. See signing/agent-auth.md and examples/sign-request/. A static collection cannot sign it for you.
